findings.reason: §5 could be started before the §3 triage verbs and the §4 stage exist, and its done-when demands a triage round through tools that would not yet be built.
findings.text: §5 says the lead triages "through the §3 tools, then re-runs the conventions stage", but the plan records no relation or gate making §5 wait on §3 or §4; the only gate on §5 (`g-sef-3`) requires `signal-cocos-conventions#s8`, and the plan's `relations` are empty and it carries no `plan-section-depends-on` meta, so a scheduler reading the plan sees §5 as independent of the triage surface it invokes

findings.reason: the node's evidence that `SignalFollowup` round-trips through the generated models and that `declared` is an accepted `EvidenceType` value would read green while no schema assertion executed, so the fix is to run that file under `-m graph` against the live graph or drop it from this node's gate.
findings.text: the `signal-followup-record` done-when runs `uv run --no-sync pytest tests/discovery/test_signal_followups.py tests/graph/test_schema_compliance.py -p no:cacheprovider`, but `tests/graph/test_schema_compliance.py` carries `pytestmark = pytest.mark.graph` (line 17) and `[tool.pytest.ini_options] addopts` in `pyproject.toml` defaults to `-m "not slow and not graph"` (lines 1017-1020), so every test in that file is deselected and the command exits 0 having run none of the schema-compliance tests

findings.reason: a node scoped away from the module that builds the state it claims to affect cannot produce the evidence its "attached evidence leading the next state" clause asserts, so either the write scope widens to include `slot_context.py` and `mapping.py` or the map-side clause is dropped.
findings.text: §4's node `followup-evidence-in-state` writes `imas_codex/discovery/signals/conventions.py`, `imas_codex/ids/slot_judgment.py` and `imas_codex/ids/models.py`, yet it asserts "their state builders put a source's attached evidence first" for the map's slot judgment as well as the conventions stage, while the map's judgment state is assembled by `build_slot_context` in `imas_codex/ids/slot_context.py` and its caller `map_signals` is in `imas_codex/ids/mapping.py` (per `mapping-decision-chain` §5)
